title: OWASP Nettacker scanner port — SMB + SSH protocols (proof-of-pattern for multi-protocol coverage)
goal: PARITY toward OWASP Nettacker: port 2 high-value protocol scanner modules (SMB + SSH) as AegisPT runners. Proof-of-pattern that we can absorb Nettacker modules; remaining ~28 protocols become an ongoing port program (backlog-430 in next sprint).
scope: (1) Clone OWASP Nettacker; extract SMB enum + SSH enum modules. (2) New `workers/runners/smb_enum/runner.py` and `workers/runners/ssh_enum/runner.py` wrapping Nettacker's logic adapted to AegisPT's RunnerExecution contract. (3) MIT license attribution + provenance file. (4) Register in capabilities.json. (5) Per backlog-409 governance: dispatch routed through control_plane. Per backlog-407: OTEL traced.
generation_reason: Per gap analysis: Nettacker has ~30 protocol modules; we have ~5 non-HTTP. Per Codex: 'AegisPT heeft meer AI/evidence ambitie, maar Nettacker is robuuster als pure recon/scanner'. SMB + SSH are highest-frequency on LAN/AD pentests. Per ANTI_DRIFT.md Rule 1: metric is 'XBOW + lab targets with SMB/SSH surface get ≥1 finding from new modules'.

constraints.active_task_gate: Single active task AND ANTI_DRIFT.md loaded.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: 2 modules only (SMB + SSH). Remaining ~28 Nettacker protocols deferred to backlog-430.
constraints.license_attribution: Nettacker is GPL; AegisPT is currently MIT-spirit. Add LICENSE notice + ATTRIBUTION.md entry. If GPL incompatibility found: file follow-up before merge.
constraints.evidence_contract: Ports MUST emit EvidenceObservation via api/app/services/evidence_ingest.make_observation — not bespoke runner-output.

success_criteria: Metric: 2 new runners registered in capabilities.json + supported_execution_tools.
Metric: smb_enum + ssh_enum each return ≥1 EvidenceObservation on a lab target (synthetic SMB/SSH server).
Metric: OTEL traces for each runner invocation.
Live: ≥1 XBOW or harness target with SMB/SSH surface produces finding from new runners.

after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with runner registration + lab findings + license note + pre-commit checklist per ANTI_DRIFT.md.
Promote backlog-424 (queue #374 — CLI/TUI) — domain-coverage sprint starts.
OR: declare parity sprint DONE + run release gate (backlog-419 re-run with new score), then operator decides next direction.
Promote next queued item into NEXT_TASK.md.
